nodes.label: POS Application Favicon SVG Icon
nodes.description: A lightning bolt / flash-shaped favicon icon (48x46px SVG). The primary shape is a two-segment zigzag lightning bolt filled with vivid purple (#863bff). Layered on top via an alpha mask are multiple blurred ellipses in deep purple (#7e14ff), soft lavender (#ede6ff), and cyan-blue (#47bfff), creating a glowing, luminous shimmer effect. Serves as the browser tab favicon and application branding mark for the POS system.

nodes.label: Icons SVG Sprite Sheet
nodes.description: SVG sprite sheet containing multiple reusable icon symbols for the POS client UI. Uses <symbol> elements with unique IDs for referencing via <use> in components.

nodes.label: Bluesky Social Icon
nodes.description: Bluesky social network logo icon. Butterfly/cloud-like abstract shape rendered in dark (#08060d). Symbol id='bluesky-icon', viewBox 16x17.

nodes.label: Discord Social Icon
nodes.description: Discord social platform logo icon. Controller/gamepad-like silhouette with two circular eyes rendered in dark (#08060d). Symbol id='discord-icon', viewBox 20x19.

nodes.label: Documentation Icon
nodes.description: Documentation/code icon. Depicts a document/file outline with code angle-bracket symbols (< >) on the right side. Rendered in purple (#aa3bff) stroke, no fill. Symbol id='documentation-icon', viewBox 21x20. Used as a UI navigation element to indicate docs or API reference.

nodes.label: GitHub Icon
nodes.description: GitHub Octocat logo icon. Distinctive cat silhouette with tentacle/octopus body rendered in dark (#08060d) filled shape. Symbol id='github-icon', viewBox 19x19.

nodes.label: Social / User Profile Icon
nodes.description: Generic social/user icon. Shows a person/user silhouette (head circle + shoulders arc) with a star/badge element indicating social status or profile. Rendered in purple (#aa3bff) stroke. Symbol id='social-icon', viewBox 20x20.

nodes.label: X (Twitter) Social Icon
nodes.description: X (formerly Twitter) logo icon. Bold X lettermark rendered in dark (#08060d) filled shape. Symbol id='x-icon', viewBox 19x19.

nodes.label: Hero Marketing Image (Isometric Layered Cards)
nodes.description: Isometric illustration of two stacked rounded-square platform shapes. The top layer is a wireframe/outline style in light gray, suggesting transparency or an empty state. The bottom layer is solid with a purple/violet gradient and glossy metallic sheen. The overall composition conveys a layered platform or card-stack concept. Used as a hero/decorative asset, likely on the login page or landing section of the POS application. Visual style is modern and minimalist, consistent with a SaaS product marketing aesthetic.

links.note: documentation-icon and social-icon share the same purple brand color (#aa3bff), suggesting they are app-specific UI icons vs the dark social media brand icons
social-icon uses the same purple brand color (#aa3bff) as documentation-icon, indicating app UI theming
